model.score: sum of the trees' leaf_value; only the order within a commit means anything

policy.review_rule: leaving one repo out over the review repos, a commented hunk ranked above an uncommented one of its snapshot more often than file-position order does, and found in the top 3 and the top 20% of snapshots with more than 3 hunks more often, losing to file position in at most 10 repos on pairwise accuracy
policy.rule: within-commit pairwise accuracy (pairs with different attention labels, a predicted tie half right): above file-position order leaving one repo out overall, below it in at most 2 repos, and above it on gold

provenance.label: attention (Opus 1-3 as lambdarank levels) + review comments (commented over uncommented per snapshot)

reference_model.what: attention head in src/hunch.json before this run, scored as current_model

tree_count.rule: smallest count within 0.005 of the best pooled leave-one-repo-out review pairwise accuracy, every 5 up to 1000

selection.rule: lightgbm lambdarank over Opus levels and review comments; no logistic alternative

policy.rule: doubt below the highest P(faithful) threshold whose leave-one-repo-out flags are unfaithful >= 0.5 of the time (>= 5 flags); passes when there it finds >= 0.2 of the unfaithful rationales and on gold >= 0.25 while flagging <= 0.03 of the faithful

tree_count.rule: smallest count within 0.005 of the best pooled leave-one-repo-out AUROC (silver and extra, weighted), every 5 up to 1000

selection.rule: the model with the higher leave-one-repo-out average precision for unfaithful rationales, lightgbm on a tie

policy.rule: noise flag; un-hide at P(skip) < unhide; hide a shown hunk at P(skip) >= 0.9

tree_count.rule: smallest count within 0.005 of the best pooled leave-one-repo-out AUROC, every 5 up to 1000

selection.rule: lightgbm if gold AUROC gain over logistic >= 0.03, or if leaving one repo out logistic makes more wrong hides than the noise flag at its hide rate and lightgbm does not, or if only lightgbm passes the promotion gate
